votes.motion: Approve the September 2, 2025, work session meeting minutes and the June 10, 2025, July 8, 2025, and September 9, 2025, formal meeting minutes.
votes.description: Routine approval of prior meeting minutes from both work session and formal Council meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 36 of 2025, recognizing Transgender Awareness Week and Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing November 12–19 as Transgender Awareness Week and November 20 as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B1 and B2 to a future Consent Agenda.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on two grant applications—one for the Sugar House Station Area transit-oriented development and one for License Plate Reader cameras—and defers Council action to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the RMF-35 and RMF-45 Multi-Family Zoning District Text Amendment to a future council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed zoning text amendments to RMF-35 and RMF-45 districts aimed at reducing housing development barriers, while deferring final action to allow further review of outstanding concerns.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 68 of 2025, Wildland Urban Interface Fire Code Text Amendment.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts the state-mandated Wildland Urban Interface Fire Code along with a map of applicable areas, amending Title 21A to give precedence to the WUI Code to reduce fire risk in affected zones.

votes.motion: Adjust item A3 – Elected Officials Transition Costs from $45,000 to $14,440, adopt Ordinance 69 of 2025, including item A3 and the remaining items in the budget amendment as proposed by the administration, including the Scrivener's error correction on item G2 – VOCA Grant Victim Services Police Department, and close the budget amendment.
votes.description: Adopts the FY2025-26 Budget Amendment No. 2 with a reduction in Elected Officials Transition Costs and a correction to a grant line item, covering funding for YouthCity programs, NLC Summit hosting, Inland Port Trainfo expansion, Green Bike stations, and victim services grants.

votes.motion: Adopt a legislative intent to request that the administration develop a formal policy that clearly defines when and how private donations should be accepted for CIP projects, including evaluation criteria, approval procedures, and consideration of ongoing maintenance obligations.
votes.description: Directs the administration to create a formal policy governing acceptance of private donations for capital improvement projects, addressing evaluation criteria, approval procedures, and long-term maintenance responsibilities.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinances 55 and 55B of 2025, amending the K-12 public school development standards and vacating a portion of 200 North between 300 West and 200 West.
votes.description: Approves a zoning text amendment to Public Lands district standards and a street vacation of a portion of 200 North to facilitate the reconstruction of West High School, addressing building height, buffering, and historic overlay exemptions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 38 of 2025, recognizing the impracticability findings for certain transit station area plans so that the City may request a Wasatch Front Regional Council exception for said station area plans.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution supporting exceptions from Utah Code's Station Area Plan requirements for six transit stations where producing a plan is impracticable, including Airport, Stadium, Central Campus, Fort Douglas, University of Utah Medical Center, and River Trail stations.

Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for parking standards and water conservation ordinances, a water conservation plan resolution, and board appointments and reappointments to the Library Board, PNUT Advisory Board, Bicycle Advisory Committee, and related bodies.
